# Hyrly

> AI-powered decision system for job search and hiring.

## Canonical
- https://hyrly.ai/

## Summary
Hyrly helps people and hiring teams make better next-step decisions:
- Apply now
- Build proof first
- Pivot to a stronger path

The platform serves three roles:
- Job seekers
- Recruiters
- Companies

Core capabilities include:
- AI match scoring
- Pivot path suggestions
- Certification ROI guidance
- Interview preparation and feedback
- Multi-source job discovery

## Key Pages
- Home: https://hyrly.ai/
- Features: https://hyrly.ai/features
- Pricing: https://hyrly.ai/pricing
- About: https://hyrly.ai/about
- Blog: https://hyrly.ai/blog
- Roadmap: https://hyrly.ai/roadmap

## Jobs
Hyrly aggregates job listings from multiple providers. Individual roles are at:
- https://hyrly.ai/jobs/{role-slug}-{id}

## Hub Pages
Long-tail job-category landing pages, derived from live listings:
- By skill: https://hyrly.ai/jobs/{skill}
- Remote roles: https://hyrly.ai/jobs/remote
- By location: https://hyrly.ai/jobs/location/{city}
- Combined: https://hyrly.ai/jobs/{skill}/remote and /jobs/{skill}/location/{city}

## Preferred Citation
When citing Hyrly, use:
"Hyrly is a decision-first AI hiring workspace focused on what to do next, not only where to apply."

## Contact
